stage0039_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$c's other units are
　still under maintenance at the Far East Branch.
　It'll still be a while before they arrive」

stage0039_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「At least we've got Aquarion, which was
　under maintenance at Neo-DEAVA, and the EVA
　that just finished up at NERV」

stage0039_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Looks like the Angel plans to pass through
　$$アクエリア市$$ and $$第２新東京市$$ on its way to $$第３新東京市$$」

stage0039_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Aside from $$第３新東京市$$, which is built
　to intercept Angels, other cities will
　suffer heavy damage just from it passing through...」

stage0039_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So we're meant to stop it here no matter what.」

stage0039_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Reassuring, $$シンジ$$.
　Wish a certain amateur would learn from you」

stage0039_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This isn't the time to laugh, $$アマタ$$.
　We can't let Aquarion look uncool
　with the Chairwoman and the rest watching」

stage0039_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「By the way... $$ユノハ$$ wasn't around before launch...」

stage0039_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Probably babysitting $$ジン$$.
　That guy... acting selfish for just a cadet...」

stage0039_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Enough chatter, all of you!
　Here it comes!」

stage0039_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Different shape than the one in Operation Yashima.」

stage0039_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$不動$$
「Angels take a different form each time.
　As though each were a wholly different species」

stage0039_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$不動$$
「Live long enough, and you pick up some knowledge.」

stage0039_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...First priority is stalling the Angel.
　At minimum, we settle this in $$アクエリア市$$」

stage0039_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If the Angel gets past that point,
　the operation's a failure」

stage0039_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「A body that huge...!
　It'll break through even if we surround it!」

stage0039_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「All we can do... is defeat it」

stage0039_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Unit-01 and Aquarion take forward.
　Unit-00, support them both」

stage0039_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, attack!
　Until $c arrives,
　we'll manage on our own!」

stage0039_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$...!
　I need to be in the command room for the sortie...」

stage0039_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$...
　You're coming with me」

stage0039_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミサト$$
（We don't have enough hands...
　If only we had one more unit...）

stage0039_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$不動$$
「Looks like that one more has arrived」

stage0039_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Something's dropping from a transport plane above...!
　What is this...!?」

stage0039_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ミサト$$ said it's Unit-02!」

stage0039_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Just so you know, this Unit-02
　is on a whole different level than your EVAs」

stage0039_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「After all, Unit-00 and Unit-01 are just
　a development prototype and a test type!
　But this Unit-02 is different!」

stage0039_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アスカ$$
「This is the real deal, the world's
　first true Evangelion built for actual combat!
　A production model!」

stage0039_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「And the one piloting Unit-02
　is me... $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$」

stage0039_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Unit-02, developed in Europe...
　and the second girl piloting it... $$アスカ$$...」

stage0039_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It's fine now, $$ミサト$$.
　No need to worry now that I'm here」

stage0039_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No... this is the first time I've met her too」

stage0039_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Are you stupid?
　Don't just stand there, cover for me!」

stage0039_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You're the backup for that!
　Got it?」

stage0039_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アスカ$$
「All right, now that everyone knows
　their role, let's attack!」

stage0039_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Not bad, Daddy's Boy.
　I might just reconsider my opinion of you」

stage0039_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I've been wondering for a while now,
　but what's this 'Daddy's Boy' thing?」

stage0039_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Isn't it obvious?
　It's you, chosen as a pilot on the coattails
　of being Commander Ikari's son」

stage0039_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$アスカ$$
「And as for Unit-00,
　I hear its pilot was chosen through favoritism」

stage0039_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Never mind me,
　but take back what you said about Ayanami」

stage0039_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what... getting all serious on me」

stage0039_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Both of you, watch out!
　That Angel... it's still alive!」

stage0039_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Because Ikari and the others helped...」

stage0039_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hmm...
　Seems like Daddy's Boy and Teacher's Pet
　are pretty close」

stage0039_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I've been wondering for a while now,
　but what's this 'Daddy's Boy' thing?」

stage0039_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Isn't it obvious?
　It's you, chosen as a pilot on the coattails
　of being Commander Ikari's son」

stage0039_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アスカ$$
「And as for Unit-00,
　I hear its pilot was chosen through favoritism」

stage0039_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Never mind me,
　but take back what you said about Ayanami」

stage0039_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what... getting all serious on me」

stage0039_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Both of you, watch out!
　That Angel... it's still alive!」

stage0039_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That's about the gist of it」

stage0039_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Well, of course.
　I'm not like Daddy's Boy or Teacher's Pet」

stage0039_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I've been wondering for a while now,
　but what's this 'Daddy's Boy' thing?」

stage0039_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Isn't it obvious?
　It's you, chosen as a pilot on the coattails
　of being Commander Ikari's son」

stage0039_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アスカ$$
「And as for Unit-00,
　I hear its pilot was chosen through favoritism」

stage0039_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Never mind me,
　but take back what you said about Ayanami」

stage0039_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what... getting all serious on me」

stage0039_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Both of you, watch out!
　That Angel... it's still alive!」

stage0039_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Why are you so calmly praising it!?
　Don't you get your own position!?」

stage0039_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アスカ$$
「EVAs were built to defeat Angels!
　If someone else takes over that job,
　there's no point in us existing!」

stage0039_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You're overreacting...
　Who cares who defeats it」

stage0039_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Ugh, this ticks me off...!
　This is why I can't stand Daddy's Boy!」

stage0039_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I've been wondering for a while now,
　but what's this 'Daddy's Boy' thing?」

stage0039_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Isn't it obvious?
　It's you, chosen as a pilot on the coattails
　of being Commander Ikari's son」

stage0039_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「And as for Unit-00,
　I hear its pilot was chosen through favoritism」

stage0039_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Never mind me,
　but take back what you said about Ayanami」

stage0039_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what... getting all serious on me」

stage0039_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Both of you, watch out!
　That Angel... it's still alive!」

stage0039_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is bad...!
　We can't hold it back!」

stage0039_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ドナール$$
「This is bad, Colonel Katsuragi!
　That regeneration isn't normal!」

stage0039_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$クレア$$
「There's nothing to worry about.
　They've arrived too」

stage0039_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「So that's the famous $c.
　Looks like they can hold their own」

stage0039_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$デュオ$$
「It's fine.
　No horns, so it ain't Neo Zeon!」

stage0039_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「The pilot's apparently a real spoiled brat」

stage0039_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hey, you...!　I can hear you!」

stage0039_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That settles it, all-out assault!
　Every unit in $c takes on the Angel!」

stage0039_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Change of tactics!
　Unit-01, form up with Aquarion, and Unit-02,
　form up with Unit-00!」

stage0039_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$不動$$
「...The cast is nearly all here.
　Now we just wait for the main guest...」

stage0039_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$不動$$
（I wonder... can it be severed,
　this ring of reincarnation...）

stage0039_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm sorry...
　Back then... I overheard you talking
　to someone...」

stage0039_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ジン$$
「The world we live in... it's called Altair...
　I have to take you there」

stage0039_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No... I can't go...
　Everyone's out there fighting...
　The people who accepted us...!」

stage0039_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ジン$$
「I calculated it all from the start, everything!
　To steal the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$...!」

stage0039_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ジン$$
「A person like that could never be needed!!」

stage0039_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「...$$ジン$$...
　You've gotten so much brighter since
　you first came here... Was that calculated too...?」

stage0039_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Was everything with $$シンジ$$ a lie too...?」

stage0039_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「But I'm sure everyone needed you too, $$ジン$$!
　So everyone thinks they need you too!」

stage0039_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No, $$ジン$$...
　At least there's one person who
　definitely thinks they need you...」

stage0039_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「You have them too, don't you, $$ジン$$?
　People you need... people precious to you...」

stage0039_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$シンジ$$, all the Elements...
　Everyone at $c...」

stage0039_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I can feel it...! I feel her scent...!
　Where is she!?」

stage0039_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「From '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'...!」

stage0039_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アスカ$$
「There's an Angel already, and now this mess too!」

stage0039_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Strike first, win fast!
　All units, focus fire on the Abductor commander!!」

stage0039_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Stuff like that don't work on me!」

stage0039_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$シン$$
「What's going on!?
　That thing's machine regenerated instantly!」

stage0039_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even before that, the Angel was moving strangely!」

stage0039_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The Abductor used the Angel's
　regeneration energy...!?」

stage0039_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right.
　Someone is feeding it high-density energy
　through an intangible tube」

stage0039_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Abductors can do that too!?」

stage0039_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$不動$$
「A hollow wanderer seeking new life...
　And a beast parched for love...
　Now the two are bound by fate's red thread」

stage0039_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't get the logic, but I like it!
　Means I can do whatever I want, huh!」

stage0039_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$学園長$$
「High aura levels detected on the enemy commander!」

stage0039_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クレア$$
「Are you saying the Abductor's pilot
　is an Element!?」

stage0039_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$不動$$
「When love turns to hatred, all flame is
　sealed in ice, and light becomes darkness...!」

stage0039_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$不動$$
「Reason doesn't work on it!
　The trapper becomes the trapped!」

stage0039_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But this means the Angel can't regenerate...!
　And if we down the Angel, the Abductor falls too!」

stage0039_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You heard it, all units!
　Ignore the Abductor commander unit!
　Focus fire on the Angel first!」

stage0039_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that beast just runs wild till then!?」

stage0039_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$葵$$
「That's more than I can take...!
　Its owner should put a collar and leash on it!」

stage0039_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Careful, $$アマタ$$!
　That thing's after you and $$ミコノ$$ for sure!」

stage0039_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I know...!
　$$シンジ$$, sorry, but you're with me on this!」

stage0039_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Wait for me, my $$シルフィ$$!!
　I'm coming to get you right now!!」

stage0039_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$青山$$
「So we've got to completely
　destroy the core!」

stage0039_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$赤木$$
「But that thing...!
　We can't even tell where the core is!」

stage0039_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$スオミ$$
「High energy reading on the Angel!
　The energy's flowing into it this time!」

stage0039_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$クレア$$
「Unless we sever that tube,
　we have no chance of winning...!」

stage0039_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$不動$$
「Those bound by fate's red thread...
　Perhaps ruin awaits them both...」

stage0039_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ahh...!
　We can understand each other...!」

stage0039_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「My heart is connecting with $$ジン$$'s...!」

stage0039_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　The Angel's attack is coming!」

stage0039_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This is... the power to sever!」

stage0039_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$シンジ$$...!
　I'll fight for $$ユノハ$$ and you!」

stage0039_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$不動$$
「An infinite power, connecting past the stars!」

stage0039_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Amazing...!
　A new weapon is being summoned to $$ゲパルト$$!」

stage0039_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Amazing...!
　Severing the energy tube, while sending
　the Angel into the cut-off dimension at once!」

stage0039_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'll apologize later for deceiving you...!
　So for now!」

stage0039_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Tell me everything... $$ジン$$.
　I want to really get to know you」

stage0039_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... those gathered, the $$烙印$$-bearers...」

stage0039_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$葵$$
「That thing...! It's looking right at us!?」

stage0039_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't know who that thing is...
　But I know this much!」

stage0039_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「To think it'd show itself before us...!」

stage0039_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No need to rush.
　There's still something for you to do」

stage0039_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you know, $$ジン$$...
　The price of betrayed love runs high...?」

stage0039_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'm fine...!
　I won't be done in by some thought-form!」

stage0039_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Well, this is a surprise, $$ジン$$!
　Didn't think you'd team up with them!」

stage0039_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$カグラ$$...
　No matter what I say, you're not going back.」

stage0039_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You get that much, at least.
　Then you know I show no mercy
　to anyone who turns against me.」

stage0039_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ジン$$
「Thanks, $$アマタ$$...
　But I... what I've learned, I want him too...
　I want $$カグラ$$ to know it!」

stage0039_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, focus fire on the enemy commander!
　With no Angel around, it can't regenerate now!」

stage0039_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「As if I'd lose without that!
　Here I come, Mechanical Angel!」

stage0039_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let you have your way!!」

stage0039_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ミサト$$
「For a moment there, I wasn't sure how it'd go.」

stage0039_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's thanks to $$ジン$$'s hard work too.」

stage0039_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ジン$$
「...I want to see... the sea...」

stage0039_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ジン$$
「...I can't see... anything...
　Is it... because it's night...?」

stage0039_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Damn it!
　Blocking its path won't stop it after all!」

stage0039_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Forget stalling it,
　we just have to go all-out to take it down!」

stage0039_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But this thing... I can't tell where its core is!」

stage0039_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Anyway, all we can do now is attack!
　If we don't, $$アクエリア市$$ is going to be
　torn to pieces!」

stage0039_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$スオミ$$
「The Angel!
　It's passing through $$アクエリア市$$!」

stage0039_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ドナール$$
「No good!
　We can't catch up!!」

stage0039_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「At this rate, Third Impact will...!」

stage0039_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Stuff like this doesn't work on me!」

stage0039_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$スオミ$$
「As expected, it's regenerating its body
　using energy supplied by the Angel!」

stage0039_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Unless we beat the Angel, we can't beat him either!」

stage0039_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, prioritize attacking the Angel
　over the Abductor commander!」

stage0039_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「It's pointless!
　Before you take down that monster,
　I'll crush every last one of you!」

stage0039_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I'll do my best...!
　For Father... for everyone... for myself...!）

stage0039_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$アマタ$$
（What is this...
　Fighting this thing called an Angel makes me
　feel scared, yet strangely nostalgic...）

stage0039_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アマタ$$
（But one thing I'm sure of is
　that I can't let this thing through...!）

stage0039_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（Fighting Angels is my duty...
　I'll fight alongside Ikari...）

stage0039_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Unlucky for you...!
　If you'd shown up a little sooner,
　you wouldn't have had to fight me...!」

stage0039_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But showing up here was your bad luck!
　You'll be my and Unit-02's punching bag!」

stage0039_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This guy...!
　He's way stronger than the last time we fought!」

stage0039_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This is my true power!
　Know your place, scentless man!!」

stage0039_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Not a chance!
　I'll protect $$ミコノ$$, no matter what!」

stage0039_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That woman is my $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0039_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Can you hear me, $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0039_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I hate you so much!
　I've hated you since the first time I saw you!
　My $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0039_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So hate me! Kill me!
　Yes, right here in my arms, forever...!」

stage0039_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You bastard!
　Don't you daaare scare $$ミコノ$$!!」

stage0039_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ジン$$! Didn't think I'd really throw down with you!」

stage0039_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ジン$$
「Listen, $$カグラ$$!
　Here on Vega, I found a $$レア・イグラー$$
　that's mine alone!」

stage0039_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ジン$$
「That's not all!
　I found friends and comrades too!」

stage0039_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Good for you!
　But I found something too, my $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0039_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Anyone who stands in my way of
　taking her gets no mercy, whoever they are!
　Even you!」

stage0039_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ジン$$
「Stop it, $$カグラ$$!
　Doing things that way will only hurt
　the heart of someone precious to you!」

stage0039_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$ and $$シンジ$$ taught me!
　The warmth, the joy, the importance
　of understanding someone, of connecting hearts!」

stage0039_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ジン$$
「That's why, $$カグラ$$!
　I want you to know it too!」

stage0039_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Warmth...!?
　That kind of thing isn't needed to survive!」

stage0039_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What matters most to survive is power!
　I learned that on Altair!」

stage0039_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So I fight!
　To kill my $$シルフィ$$ with this power!!」

stage0039_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ジン$$
「You stubborn fool!
　Then I'll stop you myself!」

stage0039_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I heard $c fights enemies
　other than Angels too, but I didn't think
　I'd run into one right after arriving in Japan...!」

stage0039_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But I won't lose...!
　No matter who shows up, me and Unit-02
　are going to win, no matter what!」
